title: First Match
goal: Two commands, two shapes: one carries a number, one carries nothing.
hints: Add carries data - its pattern needs a name for that data.
Reset carries nothing - its pattern takes no parentheses.
explanation: Patterns mirror the variant's shape exactly. `Add` holds an `i32`, so the pattern is `Command::Add(n)` - matching it bare is E0532, and the arm body needs that `n`. `Reset` holds nothing, so parentheses on it are also E0532. A guard like `_ if false` compiles nowhere here: with it the match no longer covers every case (E0004).
